name: athletly
description: Athletly monorepo: Next.js web app, Expo mobile app, and shared TS packages. (services/api is a separate Python backend.)

comments.devDependencies: Mobile pulls React 19 which npm would hoist to the repo root, where Next's shared build dep styled-jsx then resolves it instead of the web app's React 18 (dual-React build failure: 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useContext)'). Declaring React 18 at the root pins the hoisted (root) copy to 18 so the web build is self-consistent; mobile's React 19 nests under mobile/node_modules and Metro resolves it there.
